# Master Services Agreement CON-2026-014: Larkspur Retail

## 4. Service levels
Northwind Pay guarantees 99.95% monthly uptime for Hosted Checkout and Payments API.

## 5. Service credits
If monthly uptime falls below the target, the customer receives a service credit of 10% of that month's fees.
